ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace for remote mountain guides and homestays to coordinate local logistics using USDC escrow payments on Base.
ideas.title: Himalayan Nomad Agent Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Web3 and gaming partner focus of Hack in Hills '26 by leveraging autonomous agents and USDC escrow, mirroring proven winning patterns from the Synthesis Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A retro arcade mini-game themed around mountain climbing that tests blockchain and token transaction functionality in real time.
ideas.title: PeakPulse Retro Tokenizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines retro gaming creators and Web3 partner interests into a single nostalgic, high-energy demo that judges at gaming hackathons consistently reward.

ideas.pitch: A Web3 homebase where builders can customize their virtual mountain cabins, create avatars, and explore decentralized alpine worlds.
ideas.title: CryptoCrest Metaverse Cabin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages avatar creation and metaverse design, matching the exact winning formula of past metaverse and Web3 community hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multiverse agent system where MMORPG mechanics meet Web3 tokenomics to simulate survival strategies in high-altitude environments.
ideas.title: Agentic Base Camp
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with ETH Global Agentic Hackathon winning patterns by blending complex agent logic with immersive Web3 gameplay.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge gated community platform for high-altitude explorers where human climbers and AI agents can securely coexist and share secret trail maps.
ideas.title: ZKAvalanche Pass
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely hard engineering with ZK circuits and cryptography, mirroring the high technical bar that won the Synthesis Hackathon.
